clue.text: Soft gold behind sprite in sound work of art?

indicators.note: the sprite and soft gold sit inside the word for a sound

parts.note: a sound is a narrow channel of sea, also called a strait

indicators.note: the soft-gold pair comes behind, that is after, the sprite in the run

parts.note: a sprite is a fairy creature such as an elf
P (piano) is the musical abbreviation for soft
OR is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Some fairy creature made of soft gold appears within a sonorous piece of art.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts ELF plus P and OR inside STRAIT, splitting it as S...TRAIT. The question mark flags that a painting of oneself is a slightly whimsical way to define this work.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting an artist makes of themselves is one kind of artwork.

clue.text: Support aroused after editor's dismissed

indicators.note: dismissed means sent away, so those letters are dropped from the longer phrase

parts.note: aroused means stirred up
ED is the usual abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: Someone props things up once their excited editor has been fired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissed' removes ED from STIRRED UP, leaving the riding support.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider's foot rests in this metal loop hanging from the saddle, so it is a support.

clue.text: East, in card game, crafty? Not exactly

parts.note: loo is an old gambling card game

indicators.note: the compass point is placed within the word for crafty

parts.note: crafty means sly
E is the compass abbreviation for East

explanation.surface: In a card game, the player sitting East is being rather vague and cunning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like it puts East into the card game, but E goes into SLY, after the S, and LOO comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in an imprecise or approximate way is not doing it exactly.

clue.text: Cigar that's thin and brown over in dish

indicators.note: the turned colour word sits within the name of the dish

parts.note: paella is a Spanish rice dish

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the word for brown is turned the other way

parts.note: tan is a light brown colour

explanation.surface: A slim brown cigar is left lying in a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns TAN into NAT, and 'in' puts that inside PAELLA.
explanation.definitionFit: A panatella is a long slender cigar.

clue.text: Expert in public relations coming up with summary

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the whole build reads from the bottom upwards
the expert's word is set inside the abbreviation

parts.note: an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A PR expert arrives with a brief summary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts ACE inside PR to make PACER, and 'coming up' turns that around in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A short restatement of the main points is a summary.

clue.text: Hastened to woo, having no time for bitterness

parts.note: hastened means ran

indicators.note: having no signals that the abbreviation is dropped from the wooing word

parts.note: to woo is to court

explanation.surface: Someone rushed to court a lover, but with no time to spare, ill feeling followed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having no' removes T from COURT, leaving COUR after RAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is deep-seated resentment, a lasting bitterness.

clue.text: Quick to get in against antagonist

indicators.note: in signals that the answer is concealed inside the following words

explanation.surface: Someone is quick to join in opposing a rival.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across agaINST ANTagonist; 'to get' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done at once, without delay, is quick, as in an immediate reply.

clue.text: Career of skipper, caught by one, is over?

definitions.text: Career of skipper, caught by one, is over?

parts.words: Career of skipper, caught by one, is over?
parts.note: a skipper is a kind of small butterfly; its career (its flight) ends when it is caught in the collector's mesh device

explanation.surface: A ship's captain or cricket captain's working life ends when someone catches him out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Skipper' suggests a captain and 'caught' cricket, but a skipper is also a butterfly, and 'career' means a rapid flight.
explanation.definitionFit: The collector's mesh tool stops the flight of an insect such as a skipper.

clue.text: Legendary beast, one with company led by Noah initially aboard vessel

indicators.note: aboard means the pieces go inside the vessel word

parts.note: an urn is a vessel

indicators.note: led by means the initial letter comes in front of the other pieces
initially means take the first letter of the name Noah

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A mythical horned creature boards the ark with Noah in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'led by' puts N in front of I and CO, and 'aboard' puts NICO inside URN. Noah's ark suggests a boat, but the vessel is a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A unicorn is a mythical horse with a single horn, a creature of legend.

clue.text: One among players required by a game

indicators.note: required by means the build is followed by the letter given next
among means the word for one goes inside the word for players

parts.note: the players in a play are its cast
an is the indefinite article meaning one

explanation.surface: A single player is needed to make up the numbers for a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'among' puts AN inside CAST, after its C, giving CANAST; 'required by' adds A.
explanation.definitionFit: Canasta is a rummy-style card game played with two packs.

clue.text: Teller of tales in code, at last unravelled

indicators.note: something unravelled is untangled and laid out afresh, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A storyteller's message, written in code, is finally deciphered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unravelled' rearranges the twelve letters of IN CODE AT LAST.
explanation.definitionFit: An anecdotalist is someone who habitually tells short personal stories.

clue.text: People involved in run returned in pain

indicators.note: involved in means the people go inside the turned word
returned means the word for run is turned back to front

parts.note: to trot is to run gently
men are people

explanation.surface: A runner coming back is in agony, along with others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns TROT into TORT, and 'involved in' puts MEN inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Torment is severe suffering, physical or mental.

clue.text: Fuel old man has lying around

indicators.note: around means the word for lying wraps the father

parts.note: lying face down is being prone
an old man is slang for a father, a pa

explanation.surface: Dad has a supply of fuel lying about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts PRONE around PA, giving PRO-PA-NE.
explanation.definitionFit: Propane is a flammable gas used for heating and cooking, a kind of fuel.

clue.text: Power displayed in city after king's return

indicators.note: after means the city piece follows the king's letter

parts.note: R (rex) is the abbreviation for king

indicators.note: displayed in means the power letter is shown inside the city

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: Power is on show in a city once the king comes back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'displayed in' puts P inside ELY, and 'after' sets that after R. 'return' reads as a verb but means an answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A reply is an answer sent back, a return of words.

clue.text: Distressed? Considered, following comfort, less so

indicators.note: following means the considered word comes after the trimmed comfort
less means the word so is taken out of the comfort word

parts.note: solace is comfort
taken as written
considered means rated

explanation.surface: Someone upset thinks things over, receiving less comfort as a result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'less so' removes SO from SOLACE to give LACE, and 'following' puts RATED after it. The question mark marks distressed in the sense of torn.
explanation.definitionFit: Distressed can mean damaged or torn, as lacerated skin is cut and ripped.

clue.text: Queen wanting new palace, sort with no end of rooms,

indicators.note: new means the letters are formed into a fresh arrangement
with no means a letter is dropped from the word sort
end of means take the last letter of rooms

explanation.surface: A queen wants a new palace of a kind without any spare rooms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no end of rooms' drops S from SORT, leaving ORT; 'new' rearranges PALACE plus ORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleopatra was the last queen of Ptolemaic Egypt.

clue.text: What a character not in capital form may get called?

definitions.text: What a character not in capital form may get called?

parts.words: What a character not in capital form may get called?
parts.note: a letter not in capitals is a small letter, and the term for such type comes from the printer's bottom drawer of type

explanation.surface: Someone who is not a proper big-city type gets dismissed with a name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Character' and 'capital' suggest a person and a city, but they mean a letter and an upper-case letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Small letters, as opposed to capitals, are called by this printing term.

clue.text: Fighting, unrefined, upset passenger

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: raw means unrefined
a fare is a paying passenger in a taxi

explanation.surface: A crude, angry traveller starts a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns RAW into WAR, and FARE follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Warfare is armed conflict, the activity of fighting.

clue.text: Farmyard bird list? Duck's in there

indicators.note: in there means the duck goes inside the list

parts.note: a roster is a list of duties
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, the letter O

explanation.surface: A duck appears on the list of farmyard birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' looks like a farmyard bird, but it is O (a zero score in cricket), put inside ROSTER by 'in there'.
explanation.definitionFit: A rooster is a male chicken, a bird of the farmyard.

clue.text: Garment with belt worn by sailor

indicators.note: worn by is read as the sailor being wrapped inside the word for belt

parts.note: to belt is to hit hard
AB (able seaman) is the usual abbreviation for a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor wears a garment with a belt around it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'belt' looks like a strap, but it is a verb meaning HIT, which takes AB inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit is the long robe worn by a monk or nun.

clue.text: Treatment of the lion? Emergency talk takes place on it

definitions.text: Emergency talk takes place on it

indicators.note: a treatment of something works it over, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Vets debate how to treat a lion in an urgent phone call.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Treatment of' rearranges THE LION.
explanation.definitionFit: A direct telephone link kept for urgent calls, as between heads of state, is where emergency talks happen.

clue.text: Most daring combination of undergarments?

parts.note: a bra is an undergarment
a vest is an undergarment worn on the upper body

explanation.surface: Someone wonders which mix of underwear is boldest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'combination of' is a link here; a combination is also a one-piece undergarment, which adds to the joke.
explanation.definitionFit: The bravest person is the most courageous, the most daring.

clue.text: Excited over being introduced to star, turning jittery

indicators.note: being introduced to means the rearranged letters go inside the turned star
turning means the word for star is reversed

parts.note: the sun is a star

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters of over are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone excited about meeting a celebrity becomes jittery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Excited' rearranges OVER into ERVO, 'turning' makes SUN into NUS, and 'being introduced to' puts ERVO inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone jumpy and anxious is nervous.

clue.text: Fight with abandon

definitions.meaning: to ... something is to discard it

explanation.definitionFit: A scuffle is a scrap, and dropping a plan is to scrap it.

clue.text: Detective, fellow in incredible danger

parts.note: PI is a private investigator

indicators.note: the fellow's letter sits inside the word for incredible

parts.note: a tall story is an incredible one

explanation.surface: A detective and his partner are in unbelievable peril.
explanation.walkthrough: 'incredible' means TALL as in a tall tale; 'in' puts F inside it after PI.
explanation.definitionFit: A pitfall is a hidden danger or trap.

clue.text: Renegade soldiers (engaged by dictator) joining resistance

indicators.note: joining means the resistance letter is attached after the rest
engaged by means the soldiers are held inside the dictator

parts.note: Tito was the dictator of Yugoslavia
RA is the Royal Artillery, a body of soldiers
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: A renegade unit employed by a dictator throws in its lot with the resistance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engaged by' puts RA inside TITO after its first T, and 'joining' adds R.
explanation.definitionFit: A traitor is a turncoat who has betrayed his side, a renegade.

clue.text: Moment leaders of party show muscle

parts.note: in a trice means in a moment

indicators.note: leaders of means take the first letter of each of the following two words

explanation.surface: Party heads take a moment to flex their muscle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'show' looks like a verb, but it only gives its first letter, S, after P from party.
explanation.definitionFit: The triceps is the muscle at the back of the upper arm.

clue.text: Man, recast in part, keeping in trim — he'll succeed

parts.note: he is a man

indicators.note: keeping means the rearranged letters hold the trim word inside
recast means cast again in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: to pare is to trim

explanation.surface: A man is given a new role in part, keeping in shape, and expects promotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recast' rearranges IN PART into IRAPNT, and 'keeping' puts PARE inside it, after IRAP; HE goes first.
explanation.definitionFit: The one next in line to inherit a title or throne will take over, which is what succeed means here.
